therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: cholesterol absorption transporter (NPC1L1) / HDL/LDL lipid metabolism
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: cholesterol absorption inhibition (ezetimibe) / nicotinic acid receptor agonism affecting lipid metabolism (niacin)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: change in carotid intima-media thickness between groups after 14 months

safety_signals: Trial was not stopped due to safety concerns per independent steering committee

dose_info.dose_modifications: niacin titrated from 1000 mg to 2000 mg once daily

context.investigator_commentary: Independent steering committee has stopped the trial based on results of a prespecified, blinded interim analysis. It was not stopped due to safety concerns.

results_by_chain.mechanism_description: nicotinic acid receptor agonism inhibiting hepatic lipolysis and VLDL synthesis
results_by_chain.biology_description: lipid modification reducing atherosclerotic plaque progression
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with atherosclerosis enrolled in a 14-month comparative trial
